narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Krishna gets half of the land, and Bora gets a third of the land.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But the road has already taken one sixth of it.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Each gift is a fraction of what remains.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble shows 1/2 of the land; the road strip is drawn inside that half; the bubble is struck through

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Always take a fraction of what remains, and not of the first whole.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>To check, the road, the two gifts and what Somu keeps must add up to the whole land.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the words multiply by what remains, not by the original whole appear

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip says Krishna gets half of the land. The road has already taken a part, so half of the original land is not there.
